annotations.label: T cells (CCR7+ LDHB+ subset; CD4/CD8 identity and naive/memory state unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: LDHB 90% vs 61% and CCR7 46% vs 11% are enriched. CD3D is detected in 85% and CD3E in 72%, but neither differs from cluster 1. CD4 is detected in 7% and CD8A in 16%. Inference: naive-like state. Support: abstracts name CD3D/CD3E as T-cell genes, not LDHB or CCR7, so the subset is tentative. 830/852 baseline T cells were recovered in the 0.6 downsample.

annotations.label: T cells (IL7R+ LTB+ memory/activated-like; CD4/CD8 identity unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD3D 91%, CD3E 81%, IL7R 76% vs 31%, CD2, LTB and IL32 are enriched. CD40LG and TNFRSF4 are also enriched. CD4 is detected in only 15% and CD8A in 6.5%. I make no CD4 claim in the label. Support: abstracts name CD3D, CD3E and CD2 as T-cell genes, not IL7R or LTB. The label is the broad T-cell lineage only.

annotations.label: CD14+ classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: LGALS2, S100A8, S100A9, FCN1, CD14 (66% vs 3%) and LYZ are strongly enriched. FCGR3A is detected in 14%. Support: the three abstracts link S100A8/S100A9 to classical or CD14++ monocytes. They do not cover LGALS2, FCN1 or LYZ. 313/363 baseline CD14 cells stayed together in the downsample. 29 went to the DC-like cluster and 21 to FCGR3A.

annotations.label: B cells (naive-like features)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD79A 94% vs 4%, MS4A1, CD79B, TCL1A, BANK1 and VPREB3 are strongly enriched, with MHC class II genes. Support: 38770541 names CD79A and MS4A1 as B-cell markers, but in a single CLL patient, so scope is limited. Naive-like is an untested inference. Membership is identical across runs, and 235/235 baseline B cells were recovered in the downsample.

annotations.label: Cytotoxic T cells (CD8A+ GZMK+, effector/memory-like)
annotations.notes: Computed: NKG7, CCL5, GZMA, CST7, GZMK and CD8A (46% vs 7%) are enriched. CD3D is detected in 84% and KLRF1 in 5%. Versus cluster 6, CD3D, CD8A, CD8B and GZMK are higher. This split appears only from res_1 and is not testable at 0.6, so it is tentative. Support: abstracts cover NKG7, granzymes and CD8A generally, not GZMK or CCL5.

annotations.label: FCGR3A+ (CD16+) non-classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: FCGR3A 91% vs 14%, MS4A7, CDKN1C, LILRA3, CSF1R and LST1 are enriched. CD14 is detected in 16%. Support is label-level only: abstracts describe CD16+/non-classical monocytes but name none of these genes. 42794611 only uses the FCGR3A+ label. Tentative in every run. In the downsample, 100 of 109 shared baseline cells stayed together.

annotations.label: NK-like cells (CD16+ cytotoxic)
annotations.notes: Computed: GZMB, FGFBP2, PRF1, GNLY, KLRD1 and NKG7 are enriched. FCGR3A is detected in 89%, KLRF1 in 27%, CD3D in 7%, CD8A in 8%, CD4 in 0% and NCAM1 in 7%. Inference: NK rather than T cells. Support: 42682208 shows GNLY/NKG7 in NK cells, but 42609202 shows these genes in cytotoxic CD4+ T cells, so they are not NK-specific. The split is not testable at 0.6.

annotations.label: Dendritic cell-like (CD1C+ FCER1A+ cDC2-like; pDC admixture and doublets not excluded)
annotations.notes: Computed: FCER1A 83% vs 1%, CLEC10A, CD1C and SERPINF1 are enriched in 36 cells. CLEC4C, LILRA4 and IL3RA are detected in 11–17%. Median counts are 5297 vs 1757–3756 elsewhere. CD3D 17%, CD79A 17% and NKG7 33% are detected. Per-cell multi-lineage co-detection was not computed, so doublets are unresolved. Support: 38582791 covers FCER1A+CD1C+ DCs in tumor. 35101945 covers CD1c/CLEC10A cDC2 subsets in iPSC-derived cells, not FCER1A.
